{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.10

|gr1= Ropes and Sling Loading

|descr=Returns the owners of all ropes attached to the cargo - the transports to which other entities are attached with [[ropes]].

|s1= [[ropesAttachedTo]] cargo

|p1= cargo: [[Object]] - entity attached to the ends of the ropes

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Object]]s which are transports from which the ropes originate, the ropes owners

|x1= <sqf>
r1 = ropeCreate [car1, [0,0,0], car3, [0,0,0], 10];
r2 = ropeCreate [car2, [0,0,0], car3, [0,0,0], 10];
ropesAttachedTo car3; // [car1,car2]
</sqf>
